title: UPTIME returns the milliseconds since the start, and CYCLE_TIME and WATCHDOG_RESET can be called
note: The first scan runs at 0 ms and each next one scanMs later, so UPTIME() in scan 6 of a 10 ms task is 50; CYCLE_TIME is the execution time of the last cycle and is never negative; WATCHDOG_RESET is a call that does nothing visible (RT-034)
